title: Architecture Intentions NotNotes handoff
body:
Architecture Intentions dev10 emits alchemy.architecture.notnotes-publication-request/0.1, a detached, non-executable proposal with frozen architecture review and optional SSC evidence. It has no documentId, no published revision and no publication receipt until an authoritative NotNotes adapter validates document identity, writer permission, institutional policy, expected revision and retention.

A ConnectSelector route may carry the proposal, but its transport guarantees must not be confused with NotNotes document acceptance. Design approval cannot sign a document or deploy an application. A confirmed publication must return a NotNotes-issued identity, revision and proof reference, not a generated guess.

invariants: NotNotes alone owns its document truth and revision state
Transport and UI are adapters, not document authorities
No qualification can be assumed from Git source publication

provenance.claim: Exact historical source package; not a newer runtime acceptance
